```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(data.table)
  library(RColorBrewer)
})

options(warn = -1)

color_palette <- rev(brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "RdBu"))[c(1, 3)]
biotype_colors <- c(biotype1 = color_palette[1], biotype2 = color_palette[2])
category_colors <- c(
  present = "#B8AEDB",
  remission = "#91C4E8",
  unspecified = "#F4BE72",
  combined = "#B8AEDB",
  inattentive = "#91C4E8",
  hyperactive = "#F4BE72"
)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
to_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

count_yes <- function(df, vars, yes_value = 1) {
  x <- df[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  x[] <- lapply(x, to_num)

  apply(x, 1, function(v) {
    if (all(is.na(v))) return(NA_real_)
    sum(v == yes_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

check_missing_vars <- function(dat, vars) {
  missing_vars <- setdiff(vars, colnames(dat))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop("These KSADS variables are missing from dat:\n", paste(missing_vars, collapse = "\n"))
  }
}

make_count_table <- function(x) table(x, useNA = "ifany")

run_chisq <- function(dat, row_var, col_var) {
  tab <- table(dat[[row_var]], dat[[col_var]])
  list(
    count = tab,
    proportion = prop.table(tab, margin = 1),
    test = chisq.test(tab)
  )
}
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
adhd_biotype <- fread(paths$biotype)
adhd_621 <- fread(paths$subinfo) %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1", diagnosis == "adhd")

if (all(c("src_subject_id", "eventname") %in% colnames(adhd_biotype))) {
  adhd_621 <- adhd_621 %>%
    left_join(
      adhd_biotype %>% select(src_subject_id, eventname, biotype),
      by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname")
    )
} else {
  adhd_621$biotype <- adhd_biotype$biotype
}

make_count_table(adhd_621$biotype)

ksads_raw <- fread(paths$ksads)

ksads_dat <- ksads_raw %>%
  semi_join(adhd_621, by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname")) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

## Derive ADHD presentation

```{r symptom-variables}
current_inatt <- c(
  "ksads_14_394_p", "ksads_14_76_p", "ksads_14_395_p",
  "ksads_14_396_p", "ksads_14_397_p", "ksads_14_398_p",
  "ksads_14_399_p", "ksads_14_80_p", "ksads_14_400_p"
)

current_hyper <- c(
  "ksads_14_401_p", "ksads_14_84_p", "ksads_14_402_p",
  "ksads_14_403_p", "ksads_14_404_p", "ksads_14_405_p",
  "ksads_14_406_p", "ksads_14_407_p", "ksads_14_408_p"
)

onset_before_12_var <- "ksads_14_429_p"
impairment_var <- "ksads_14_409_p"
needed_vars <- c(current_inatt, current_hyper, onset_before_12_var, impairment_var)

check_missing_vars(ksads_dat, needed_vars)
```

```{r derive-presentation}
present_labels <- c(
  "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation",
  "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation",
  "ADHD combined presentation"
)

result <- ksads_dat %>%
  mutate(
    current_inatt_n = count_yes(., current_inatt),
    current_hyper_n = count_yes(., current_hyper),
    onset_before_12 = to_num(.data[[onset_before_12_var]]),
    impairment_meets = to_num(.data[[impairment_var]]) == 1,
    inatt_meets = current_inatt_n >= 6,
    hyper_meets = current_hyper_n >= 6,
    adhd_presentation = case_when(
      is.na(inatt_meets) | is.na(hyper_meets) |
        is.na(onset_before_12) | is.na(impairment_meets) ~ NA_character_,
      inatt_meets & !hyper_meets & onset_before_12 == 1 & impairment_meets ~
        "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation",
      !inatt_meets & hyper_meets & onset_before_12 == 1 & impairment_meets ~
        "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation",
      inatt_meets & hyper_meets & onset_before_12 == 1 & impairment_meets ~
        "ADHD combined presentation",
      TRUE ~ "No current ADHD diagnosis"
    ),
    adhd_diagnosis = if_else(adhd_presentation %in% present_labels, 1, 0),
    adhd_subtype_code = case_when(
      adhd_presentation == "ADHD combined presentation" ~ 1,
      adhd_presentation == "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation" ~ 2,
      adhd_presentation == "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation" ~ 3,
      adhd_presentation == "No current ADHD diagnosis" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    src_subject_id, eventname,
    current_inatt_n, current_hyper_n,
    onset_before_12, impairment_meets,
    inatt_meets, hyper_meets,
    adhd_diagnosis, adhd_presentation, adhd_subtype_code
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    adhd_621 %>% select(src_subject_id, eventname, ksads_adhd, biotype, age, sex),
    by = c("src_subject_id", "eventname")
  )

write.csv(result, paths$output, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Descriptive tables

```{r descriptive-tables}
list(
  presentation = make_count_table(result$adhd_presentation),
  subtype_code = make_count_table(result$adhd_subtype_code),
  biotype = make_count_table(result$biotype),
  onset_before_12 = make_count_table(result$onset_before_12),
  impairment_meets = make_count_table(result$impairment_meets),
  inatt_meets = make_count_table(result$inatt_meets),
  hyper_meets = make_count_table(result$hyper_meets),
  biotype_by_presentation = table(result$biotype, result$adhd_presentation, useNA = "ifany"),
  biotype_by_presentation_prop = prop.table(table(result$biotype, result$adhd_presentation), margin = 1)
)
```

## Categorical comparisons

```{r categorical-comparisons}
dat_diag <- result %>%
  filter(!is.na(biotype), !is.na(ksads_adhd)) %>%
  mutate(biotype = factor(biotype), ksads_adhd = factor(ksads_adhd))

diag_stats <- run_chisq(dat_diag, "biotype", "ksads_adhd")
diag_stats$count
diag_stats$proportion
diag_stats$test

present_dat <- result %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(biotype),
    !is.na(ksads_adhd),
    !is.na(adhd_presentation),
    ksads_adhd == "present",
    adhd_presentation != "No current ADHD diagnosis"
  ) %>%
  mutate(biotype = factor(biotype), adhd_presentation = factor(adhd_presentation))

presentation_stats <- run_chisq(present_dat, "biotype", "adhd_presentation")
presentation_stats$count
presentation_stats$proportion
presentation_stats$test
```

## Sankey plots

```{r sankey-functions}
source(paths$sankey_fun)

sankey_defaults <- list(
  pdf_file = NULL,
  link_alpha = 0.30,
  node_alpha = 0.95,
  font_size = 22,
  node_width = 22,
  node_padding = 28,
  width = 900,
  height = 500,
  zoom = 2
)

make_sankey_pair <- function(config) {
  dat_plot <- config$dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[config$left_var]]), !is.na(.data[[config$right_var]]))

  common_args <- c(
    list(
      dat = dat_plot,
      left_var = config$left_var,
      right_var = config$right_var,
      left_levels = config$left_levels,
      right_levels = config$right_levels,
      left_name_map = config$left_name_map,
      right_name_map = config$right_name_map,
      left_color_key_map = config$left_color_key_map,
      right_color_key_map = config$right_color_key_map,
      color_map = config$color_map
    ),
    sankey_defaults
  )

  with_text <- do.call(
    plot_sankey_networkD3,
    modifyList(common_args, list(
      html_file = paste0(config$file_prefix, ".html"),
      png_file = NULL,
      show_text = TRUE
    ))
  )

  without_text <- do.call(
    plot_sankey_networkD3,
    modifyList(common_args, list(
      html_file = paste0(config$file_prefix, "_notext.html"),
      png_file = NULL,
      show_text = FALSE
    ))
  )

  list(with_text = with_text, without_text = without_text)
}
```

```{r sankey-configs}
biotype_name_map <- c(biotype1 = "ADHD-1", biotype2 = "ADHD-2")
biotype_key_map <- c(biotype1 = "biotype1", biotype2 = "biotype2")

sankey_configs <- list(
  diagnosis = list(
    dat = result,
    left_var = "biotype",
    right_var = "ksads_adhd",
    left_levels = c("biotype1", "biotype2"),
    right_levels = c("present", "remission", "unspecified"),
    left_name_map = biotype_name_map,
    right_name_map = c(present = "Present", remission = "Remission", unspecified = "Unspecified"),
    left_color_key_map = biotype_key_map,
    right_color_key_map = c(present = "present", remission = "remission", unspecified = "unspecified"),
    color_map = c(biotype_colors, category_colors[c("present", "remission", "unspecified")]),
    file_prefix = "biotypes_vs_diagnostic_labels"
  ),
  presentation = list(
    dat = present_dat,
    left_var = "biotype",
    right_var = "adhd_presentation",
    left_levels = c("biotype1", "biotype2"),
    right_levels = c(
      "ADHD combined presentation",
      "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation",
      "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation"
    ),
    left_name_map = biotype_name_map,
    right_name_map = c(
      "ADHD combined presentation" = "Combined",
      "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation" = "Inattentive",
      "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation" = "Hyperactive/impulsive"
    ),
    left_color_key_map = biotype_key_map,
    right_color_key_map = c(
      "ADHD combined presentation" = "combined",
      "ADHD predominantly inattentive presentation" = "inattentive",
      "ADHD predominantly hyperactive/impulsive presentation" = "hyperactive"
    ),
    color_map = c(biotype_colors, category_colors[c("combined", "inattentive", "hyperactive")]),
    file_prefix = "biotypes_vs_adhd_presentations"
  )
)
```

```{r run-sankey}
sankey_plots <- lapply(sankey_configs, make_sankey_pair)

# Each widget is printed explicitly so that it is embedded in the rendered HTML.
sankey_plots$diagnosis$with_text
sankey_plots$diagnosis$without_text
sankey_plots$presentation$with_text
sankey_plots$presentation$without_text
```
